notes: §2002:14.8.6.3 GR1: every CLOSE form of a not-open connector, including WITH LOCK, is unsuccessful with 42 (C1..C5, C7, C8), and a successful CLOSE WITH LOCK gives 00 (C6). --std 2002 run matched. §2002:9.1.12: a 42 status is fatal and the implementor decides whether execution continues; DOC-A.1-103: it continues, because the file has a FILE STATUS clause and EC-I-O checking is not enabled.
